mapper.update: MERGE INTO A1MFG.OP_FAB_TYPE A USING( SELECT #{DEPT_ID} DEPT_ID,#{SDEPT_CNAME} SDEPT_CNAME,#{EMP_ID} EMP_ID,#{CNAME} CNAME,#{FAB_TYPE} FAB_TYPE,#{UPDATE_USER} UPDATE_USER FROM DUAL )B ON (A.DEPTID=B.DEPT_ID AND A.EMPID=B.EMP_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.FAB_TYPE=B.FAB_TYPE,A.UPDATE_USER=B.UPDATE_USER,A.UPDATE_TIME=SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT(DEPTID,SDEPTNAME,EMPID,CNAME,FAB_TYPE,UPDATE_TIME,UPDATE_USER) VALUES(B.DEPT_ID,B.SDEPT_CNAME,B.EMP_ID,B.CNAME,B.FAB_TYPE,SYSDATE,B.UPDATE_USER)
mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(T.SHIFT_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY-MM-DD') ym, --A.ym, '42'||DECODE(T.SHIFT,'D','日','N','夜')||SUBSTR(T.AB_SHIFT,1,1)||'班' aclass,'all' sdeptname FROM (SELECT SHIFT_DATE,SHIFT,AB_SHIFT,STARTDATETM+0.5/24 STARTDATETM,ENDDATETM+0.5/24 ENDDATETM FROM ODS.WP_CALENDAR WHERE SHIFT_DATE=TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-6/1440-8/24,'YYYYMMDD'))T, (SELECT TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-6/1440-8/24,'YYYYMMDD') SHIFT_DATE,(SYSDATE-6/1440) DATETIME FROM DUAL)A WHERE --T.SHIFT_DATE=A.SHIFT_DATE AND A.DATETIME>=T.STARTDATETM AND A.DATETIME<=T.ENDDATETM

SELECT '42'||DECODE(T.SHIFT,'D','日','N','夜')||SUBSTR(T.AB_SHIFT,1,1)||'班' ACLASS_VALUE ,'42'||DECODE(T.SHIFT,'D','日','N','夜')||SUBSTR(T.AB_SHIFT,1,1)||'班' ACLASS_LABEL FROM ODS.WP_CALENDAR T WHERE T.SHIFT_DATE=#{shift_date} AND T.SHIFT_HOUR IN ('01','20') ORDER BY T.SHIFT

SELECT DISTINCT SHIFT_MONTH YM_VALUE,SHIFT_MONTH YM_LABEL FROM A1MFG.OP_FAB_SUM ORDER BY SHIFT_MONTH DESC
